'''Trina Bek''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Alderaan Civil War]], she spent [[Time/Legends|time]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], in the [[Shining Star cantina]] on the grounds of [[House Organa (estate)|House Organa]]. Bek sometimes shared her knowledge with other smugglers.<ref name="TOR" />
